_written: BEFORE any run. Expected results exactly as given by the requester, plus the concrete fixture parameters chosen for them.

fixture.campaign: google_ads campaign coh-A, mapped to B10; accepted spend $100 on 2026-10-03 + $100 on 2026-10-04 = $200
fixture.inquiries: two calls from two different phones, both source 'Google Ads', campaign coh-A, tagged B10 (P1 2026-10-06, P2 2026-10-07)
fixture.bookings: P1 -> CRM customer 9101 / subscription 9201 at office 111 (B11), initial service completed 2026-10-09; P2 -> customer 9102 / subscription 9202 at office 110 (B10), cancelled 2026-10-09 before its initial service
fixture.cash: customer 9101: payment 9501 +$120 on d1=2026-10-10, payment 9502 +$80 on d2=2026-10-15, refund 9503 -$20 (of 9502) on d3=2026-10-22; payment 9502 re-delivered unchanged on 2026-10-16
fixture.cutoffs: c1 = 2026-10-12T00:00Z (between d1 and d2); c2 = after d3 (period end 2026-10-31T00:00Z)

expected: A paid campaign mapped to Branch A has $200 accepted spend (one or more spend days).
Two distinct inquiries (leads from two different people) are linked to that campaign. Both book.
One booking completes its first service at Branch B (the customer's CRM office / servicing branch is B). The other booking cancels before service.
Expected: two bookings, one completed first service, one cancellation — NOT two acquired customers.
The serviced customer pays $120 (day d1), later pays $80 (d2), later receives a $20 refund (d3). A retry (re-delivery) of the $80 payment must not change totals.
Expected net collected cash: $120 at a cutoff between d1 and d2; $180 after all three events.
Expected, under an explicit campaign-cohort basis: cost per booking $100; cost per completed first service $200.
The same $200 must NOT also be assigned to Branch B, and Branch B's CAC must not be presented as comparable without a branch-credit policy.
No renewal history -> no defensible lifetime value.
